posts.title: FC 27 Thunderstruck Promo Event
posts.description: Black Friday: Thunderstruck brings a storm to Football Ultimate Team in FC 27. Discover dynamic Player Items with upgrades based on real-world performances, earn themed rewards in the new Token Store, and take part in a variety of limited-time challenges. FC 27 Thunderstruck Promo Event Thunderstruck Token Store Log in to Football Ultimate Team during the two-week campaign to receive 100 Thunderstruck Tokens. More than 4,000 Tokens will be available throughout the event, including through themed Objectives. Spend your Tokens in the Thunderstruck Token Store on rewards such as Player Items, Packs and Evolutions. Thunderstruck Players and ICONs From legendary ICONs to current stars, Thunderstruck brings multiple player releases to Football Ultimate Team . Selected current Player Items are dynamic and can receive upgrades based on their clubs’ domestic league performances. Tracking begins on November 20 for Team 1 and November 27 for Team 2. posts.title: FC 27 Unleashed Event
posts.description: Welcome back some of the most feared and revered Player Items in Football Ultimate Team history with FC 27 Hall of FUT: Unleashed, honoring era-defining legends from 18 years of FUT folklore. FC 27 Hall of FUT: Unleashed Event Hall of FUT: Unleashed celebrates fan favorites from 18 years of Football Ultimate Team history. Following the induction of 21 players into the Hall of FUT at the start of the season, Unleashed releases upgraded versions of these Player Items into packs with boosted stats and a brand-new Unleashed design. Throughout the campaign, you can unlock special items, packs, and customization rewards across several dedicated modes and features: Weekly Play Objectives: Kicking off a full month of Weekly Play Objectives, complete a new challenge each week to finish the Weekly Play Completionist Objective group and earn a 1 of 3 Hall of FUT: Unleashed Player Pick alongside other rewards. posts.title: FC 27 Road to the Knockouts Promo Event
posts.description: UEFA Road to the Knockouts returns to Football Ultimate Team 27 with live Player Items from the UEFA Champions League, UEFA Women’s Champions League, UEFA Europa League and UEFA Conference League. Their upgrades depend on their clubs’ wins, goals and final League Phase positions. Each RTTK item can earn three upgrades. The requirements vary by competition: UEFA Champions League and UEFA Europa League Three League Phase wins: +1 Base PlayStyle. At least one club goal in three separate matches: +1 to two position-specific face stats. A top-eight League Phase finish: +1 OVR. UEFA Conference League Two League Phase wins: +1 Base PlayStyle. At least one club goal in two separate matches: +1 to two position-specific face stats. A top-eight League Phase finish: +1 OVR. UEFA Women’s Champions League Two League Phase wins: +1 Base PlayStyle. At least one club goal in two separate matches: +1 to two position-specific face stats. A top-four League Phase finish: +1 OVR.
